Tune in to the this melodious song Chaman Mein Rehke from the movie Deedar (1951) starring Ashok Kumar, Nargis, Dilip Kumar and Nimmi in the lead along with others.
Credits:

Singers: Shamshad Begum
Music: Naushad

Movie: Deedar
Cast: Ashok Kumar, Nargis, Dilip Kumar and Nimmi
